limits: Only B1/B2 are joined by the explicit two-part header. C is a separate inquiry about a dragoman whose leave is ending.
The native 164, 110, 348 source lengths all match. Restoring B1 final FDGD corrects the earlier OCR, not the historical source.

The main readings use 11 observed-coordinate substitutions and one damaged-glyph fill. C source 45 is conservatively masked; its former X-to-V substitution becomes a V fill. The main candidate still requires four coordinate operations. No source insertion/deletion, rank change or global key/numeral reassignment is used.

The explicit C source 45 X and V branches are same-source glyph assumptions. Their fully assigned raw streams are not additional physical records or observations. Earlier OCR uncertainty at this slot is not a parallel witness.
PFESS, G H1 Q, VERBETZ and the ?BA AEK11 closing are retained; no place, office or opaque reference is forced into a familiar spelling.
C retains the exact address sequence GEHEIMRATENDERHEIDENBRAILA and the spelling SCHAEFER. No independent personal identity or surname normalization is claimed.
The conditional wording SOFERN UEBERHAUPT AUSFUEHRBAR and the question about whether return is desired are retained. No completed return or train movement is asserted.
The printed dash at B2 source 39 gives plaintext position 40 domain 3BFKQS and remains unknown; all six exact completions are retained as witnesses, not historical solutions.
Previously cataloged p107 D and the separate RIZI p107 A are excluded from the proposal and counts.
Earlier body candidates, unread OCR frames and published key provenance are retained. Exact re-encryption certifies compatibility, not historical uniqueness.
